parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate, a lightweight and flexible plastic material.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain balance and fit.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate, providing flexibility and comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the glasses in place on the right side of the wearer’s head and ensures stability.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or open outward for use.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, consisting of the frame and lenses. The frame is typically metal, and the lenses are glass or polycarbonate.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position for vision correction or protection and provides the structural integrity of the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support structure connecting both legs and lenses.
